intro: StorageCafe has no city statistics page for Bangor. UnitSight's September 2026 street-rate index, from 8 facilities and 85 listings, puts the standard 10x10 at $153. SpareFoot's unspecified 10x10 average was $134.02 on September 1, 2026, included here as $134. The advertised rate averages those two figures. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (UnitSight street rates; SpareFoot 10x10 average). No StorageCafe industry-statistics page; no StorageUnitCosts city page; no Storage Stats market page.

units.notes: UnitSight standard street rate $107 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$108. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).
UnitSight standard street rate $153 (Sep 2026), 8 facilities. SpareFoot unspecified average $134.02 on Sep 1, 2026, rounded to $134. Climate-controlled on the UnitSight page ~$145.

local_tips: UnitSight tracks 8 facilities and 85 listings in Bangor (September 2026).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
